sources.title: TTRL: Test-Time Reinforcement Learning - arXiv.org
sources.snippet: TTRL directly addresses the problem of training models via RL without explicit supervision, investigating a model's ability to explore and learn in this challenging yet critical setting. Essentially, TTRL enables the model to generate its own experiences, estimate rewards, and improve its performance over time.
